# Text that reaches the watch (issues 20261122-9689, 6b60, d379): through the real decoder, a cut
# string never ends in half a character and ends in "…"; U+FFFD (text the daemon withheld) is the
# eye-slash glyph; an rx line may carry a long frame; the AGENT readout cuts the model's name, never
# the pull request's number.
connect
rtc 1800000000
rx a400020101020103a5008200181801a30048a1a2a3a4a5a6a7a801696465762d6c696e7578020202a2001a6aee31c0013901df03a200010100048368436f6e74696e7565635965736d52756e20746865207465737473
session 1 work x x
# repo: 42 bytes; host name cut inside a Cyrillic letter
rx a3000401186503a4000104782a612d7265616c6c792d6c6f6e672d7265706f7369746f72792d6e616d652d746861742d676f65732d6f6e0b010c781bd181d0b5d180d0b2d0b5d180d18b2dd181d0b1d0bed180d0bad0b8
# branch with text the daemon withheld (U+FFFD)
rx a3000401186603a200010569efbfbd2d6c6f67696e
# a 300-byte summary, past the old 255-byte rx limit
rx 
wait 500
shot strings_clip_card.png
expect_label a-really-long-repository-name…
expect_label сервер…
# U+FFFD arrives as the eye-slash glyph (U+E224)
expect_label -login
expect_no_label �
expect_label éééééééééé
# the AGENT readout: a long model name gives way to the mode and the whole pull request number
gauge 1 100 Claude_Opus_4.5_[1m] bypass 123456 changes
wait 300
tap 233 233
wait 500
shot strings_clip_agent.png
expect_screen agent
expect_label … · Bypass · PR 123456
btn B long
wait 400
# an option longer than its 24 bytes, through the real decoder: cut with its mark
session 2 input webapp feat/login
attention 7 2 approval approve,deny,focus 3 Edit file|src/auth.ts|Yes|Yes, don't ask again for this|No
wait 700
shot strings_clip_ask.png
expect_screen ask
expect_label Yes, don't ask again…
quit
